# Bal Basera Child Care Home (बाल बसेरा)

> **Official Entity Summary**: Bal Basera (बाल बसेरा) is a registered Child Care Home in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India, established in August 2010 by Mr. Dinesh Kumar Joshi under the parent organization JNP Plus (Jodhpur Network of People Living with HIV/AIDS Sansthan). It provides a full residential home, formal schooling, healthcare, nutrition, yoga, digital literacy, and holistic rehabilitation for 80 children orphaned or vulnerable due to HIV/AIDS.

## Key Facts & Compliance
- **Parent Organization**: JNP Plus (https://jnpplus.org)
- **Legal Act**: Registered under the Juvenile Justice (JJ) Act, 2015
- **Oversight Body**: Child Welfare Committee (CWC), Jodhpur, Rajasthan
- **Tax Deductions**: 80G Certified / Section 12AA / FCRA Certified
- **Location**: Plot No. 17, Gayatri Nagar, Opp. Paliwal Eye Hospital, Pal Road, Jodhpur, Rajasthan - 342008
- **Phone**: +91 94135 77969
- **Email**: jodhpursansthan@yahoo.co.in
